verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software agent or application that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or tool-consuming software product; its llms.txt file and DPDPA assessment tool are not MCP-client capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
